title: Filing a Marketplace Valuation on the Condition Record of a Keyturn Vehicle Listing
content:
When the marketplace has valued a vehicle offered as a Keyturn Vehicle Listing, the valuation is filed on that vehicle's condition record. One record carries a single dated valuation: the odometer the valuation was made on, the money figure the marketplace has put on the vehicle, the value class that figure falls in, and how the valuation was produced. Nothing on the listing itself moves — the vehicle keeps the class and the value it already carries — and what becomes visible is a fresh valuation entry that later readings of the vehicle's valuation history return.

A valuation the marketplace records once its refresh interval has fallen due is its own inspector's assessment of the vehicle, is recorded under that channel, and is made on the odometer standing on the listing at the handling date.

### Making the entry

The desk unlocks the agent-side tool `record_vehicle_valuation_559b4236` and calls it. One call files one valuation.

### Parameters

- `vehicle_id` — the listing reference number of the vehicle being valued, read from the vehicle listing lookup before the call.
- `customer_id` — the member reference number of the host who owns that listing, read from the member profile lookup before the call.
- `odometer_reading` — the odometer the valuation was made on, in whole miles as an integer, with no decimal part, no unit suffix and no thousands separator.
- `assessed_value_amount` — the money figure the marketplace has put on the vehicle, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half away from zero at the point it is filed; an amount of 0.00 means no figure was established.
- `value_class_assessed` — the value class the filed figure places the vehicle in, exactly one of: `unassessed`, the record establishes no class for the vehicle; `Keyturn Economy Class Listing`, the figure falls in the entry value band; `Keyturn Standard Class Listing`, the figure falls in the standard value band; `Keyturn Premium Class Listing`, the figure falls in the premium value band; `Keyturn Luxury Class Listing`, the figure falls in the luxury value band; `Keyturn Exotic Class Listing`, the figure falls in the exotic value band; `Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing`, the vehicle is a commercially plated van and the figure falls in the commercial van value band.
- `inspection_channel` — how the valuation was produced, exactly one of: `self_photo`, from photographs the host supplied; `partner_shop`, from a partner workshop's assessment of the vehicle; `mobile_inspector`, from a marketplace inspector who attended the vehicle; `telematics_report`, from the data the fitted telematics unit returns.

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the reference number minted for the new valuation record, the listing it was filed against, the money figure recorded to 2 decimal places and the value class that figure falls in. The presence of that reference number in the sentence is what indicates the valuation now stands on the vehicle's condition record.
